constraints: Raises an error if the requested deletion would remove all sections or if the document contains only one section.

Deleting a section also removes everything anchored to it (header, footer, part of the body, anchored pictures, text boxes, and the ending section break), and re-indexes the anchorSection attribute of remaining text boxes/pictures.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Deletes a single already-referenced section object directly (e.g. one previously returned by WP Get section).
Deletes one or more sections of wpDoc starting at indexNumber, removing count sections (default 1) when count is passed.
